entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to modify a PDU session.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: Message used to report error conditions in 5G session management.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to carry session management messages.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Indicates the cause of a 5G session management event or error.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure transaction identity used to correlate session management procedures.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: State indicating a PDU session is inactive.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ACTIVE
entities.description: State indicating a PDU session is active.

entities.name: PDU session inactive for the received PDU session ID
entities.description: Condition where the PDU session ID in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND belongs to a PDU session in inactive state.

entities.name: Collision of network-requested and UE-requested PDU session modification procedures
entities.description: Condition where the UE receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND during an ongoing UE-requested modification procedure for the same PDU session.

entities.name: Abort UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Behavior where the UE internally aborts its ongoing PDU session modification procedure.

relations.description: When PDU session is inactive, UE sends 5GSM STATUS message with cause #43.
5GSM STATUS message contains 5GSM cause IE set to #43.
5GSM STATUS message contains PDU session ID IE set to received value.
5GSM STATUS is sent via UL NAS TRANSPORT message.
Procedure collision condition causes UE to abort its ongoing modification procedure.
Procedure collision condition causes UE to enter PDU SESSION ACTIVE state.
Procedure collision condition causes UE to proceed with network-requested modification procedure.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND contains PDU session ID IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND contains PTI IE.
Procedure collision condition is guarded by PTI IE being set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'.
